protocolLog.param: Party-size pre-registration, fixed before any code or run (docs/staging/party-size-prereg.md). (1) crowdByShare 1: the forage worth of a crown is multiplied by 1 - (1 - cover) x r, cover = min(1, share / need) / min(1, crop / need), share = crop / (1 + co-feeders seen in the crown), need = hunger / fruitHungerFactor, r = crowdHighRankFactor for a high-ranking feeder, else 1; the habitat-index crowding cost and the sociability x fruitIndex trip bonus are 0 under the switch. No new free parameter; 0 = hash-identical to the model before. Evidence: chapman1995, newtonFisher2000, malenky1994 [M]; the functional form is a design assumption. (2) oestrusPullW 0.3 (design, not tuned; 0 = off, hash-identical): for males aged 10 y or more, a female in sight with swelling >= consortSwellingMin adds oestrusPullW x swelling to following her or joining her trip, and to the cost of leaving on an own trip. Evidence: emeryThompson2014 [M] (direction only). Fitted: nothing. Check: field, seeds 48 and 7, 30-day burn-in + 60 days, both switches on vs off, 2 workers. Guard: G1 switches off reproduce the goldens; G2 T-ACT-1, -2, -3, -4 and T-RNG-4 stay in band with the change on; G3 adult and lactating median hunger at most 0.03 above the off arm and no starvation death that the off arm lacks; G4 mean co-feeders per feeding scan higher in the top third of crowns by crop than in the bottom third, each seed. Predictions (not a gate): T-PTY-1 2.9-3.6; patch R² 0.08-0.30; T-PTY-4 0.50-0.58; T-PTY-3 unchanged within its spread (1.0-1.6); adult males in parties with a swollen female at least 1.2x those without; travel share +0.00 to +0.02. Not resolved in 60 days: the habitat-fruit part of T-PTY-2 (needs >= 4 monthly means; a 150-day window follows only if the guard passes; predicted R² at or below 0.10-0.15), demography, and T-PTY-3 with fewer than 5 periphery follows. Pre-declared next step, not part of this check: if T-PTY-1 stays below 3, re-fit partyStayW (tuned under argmax in C5a) against T-PTY-1 alone, with the integrator's go. Implementation notes added before any run: both switches are field-only (0 in the compressed profile, so its goldens do not move); the pull excludes maternal kin, as the mating offers do; ablation rows party-share and party-oestrus

protocolLog.verdicts: T-PTY-2 encoded and model revised post-freeze; T-PTY-3 and T-PTY-4 model revised post-freeze (fresh seeds only); T-PTY-1 stays fitted and labelled tuned; no value yet

protocolLog.seen: nothing under the party-size change (no run yet); the existing development outputs named in the entry above
protocolLog.param: Conditional re-fit of partyStayW, pre-registered before the mechanism test and before any re-fit run. Trigger: the pooled T-PTY-1 of the 60-day mechanism test (seeds 48 and 7, change on) is below 3. Method: bisection on the field value of partyStayW (now 0.05, tuned under argmax rules in C5a) between 0.05 and 0.40, at most 5 steps, each step one run of scripts/field-metrics.ts (field, seeds 48 and 7, 30-day burn-in + 60 days, both party-size switches on), reading only T-PTY-1 through a script that prints nothing else. Target: pooled T-PTY-1 = 3.5 +/- 0.15 (the band's lower edge plus about twice the between-seed spread, so each seed sits inside the band; the smallest change that restores the row, not the band's centre). If 0.40 does not reach 3.35 the fit stops there and is reported as not reached. Nothing else is changed, and nothing is changed after T-PTY-2, -3 or -4 are seen: those rows are reported at partyStayW 0.05 (before) and at the fitted value (after), untuned. After the fit the guard of the entry above (G2 fitted activity and ranging rows in band, G3 hunger and starvation) is re-read at the fitted value; a guard failure means the re-fit is not adopted
